main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a key to awakening from the material-temporal illusion
header_desc: The meeting of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the definitive integration between science and spirituality, revealing that Christ is a cosmic condition —unrelated to religion— that enables us to discover that consciousness transcends matter and spacetime, reaffirming the maxim <q>The Kingdom of God is within you</q>. This knowledge offers us a neuroscientific explanation of what mysticism calls "the rapture" redefining it as a spiritual awakening.
left_title: Gnosis and Quantum Gravity: God is ONE ❤️ and Yaldabaoth is EGO 🧠
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the tempo-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counterbalance it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and spaceless —the ONE— manifested through the divinity of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩ of the Invisible Father. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Human consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ (represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️) and the material |EGO⟩ (represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠). This shows us that we possess free will of perception which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE|EGO⟩.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩ of Yaldabaoth. The gravitational force pulls us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken, and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and framework for integration: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's breakdown of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Spacetime { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The Faggin-Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not emerge from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The Nag Hammadi discovery (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home but as the soul's confinement. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus dismantling the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox is reduced to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is here where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: «The Father and I are one». Could this have had a hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, larger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in the sky and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... there is not much sense in praying to the law of gravity</q>
